runJsonPolicy: Do not create run.json until native Logic captures, exact environment, state, render, analysis, and reload evidence exist.

processing.lowLatencyModeEvidence: Record the visible Logic setting; null is valid only with an evidence note.

trackChannelFormats: stereo source through stereo Direction Mixer instance
mono source through stereo output only for baseline/control; never call this stereo-instance evidence

fixturePackage.manifestAuthority: Use each manifest record for file name, frame count, channel count, sample rate, encoding, purpose, and SHA-256; do not hand-edit manifest values.

required.role: latency, polarity, gain, impulse response, and tail
interchannel delay, phase, and mono compatibility
100 Hz mid/low plus 5 kHz side/high frequency-dependent transfer

supplemental.role: supplemental synthetic audition probe; not real guitar evidence
supplemental synthetic audition probe; not real bass evidence
supplemental synthetic audition probe; not a perceptual-quality reference

primary.method: Logic Pro Project or Section Bounce
primary.cycleRange: exactly the manifest duration for the selected fixture
primary.tailHandling: no extra tail for Direction Mixer; if any extra frames are rendered, retain but reject for the fixed-length evidence artifact

diagnosticSecondary.method: Logic Pro real-time Project or Section Bounce
diagnosticSecondary.scope: one header-bypass state and one settled split state per decisive fixture, only if available

alignment.cycleStart: record exact bar/beat and sample position

artifactNaming.projectArchivePattern: project/TrackSmith Logic 12.3 Direction Mixer Production Profile 48k 2026-08-02.logicx.zip
artifactNaming.pathRule: All artifact paths are relative to this run directory; never overwrite a fixture or reuse a path for a different state.

stateCapture.unknownValuePolicy: If the current Logic UI does not expose an exact numeric range/value in local documentation, record the exact visible UI label/value and screenshot; never invent a value.

headerStates.purpose: same-path bypass and source identity baseline
freshly inserted documented default; record every visible control

states.selectionRule: Select the neutral/center marker; record the exact visible value.
Select the visible quarter-turn left position relative to center; record the exact visible value or angle.
Select the visible quarter-turn right position relative to center; record the exact visible value or angle.
Select the supported left extreme that can swap or isolate channel direction; record the exact visible value.
Select the supported right extreme that can swap or isolate channel direction; record the exact visible value.

directionGrid.interpretationBoundary: Direction labels are state selectors only; no localization or artistic claim is made until channel, mono, and source listening evidence exist.

LR.selectionRule: Select the lower supported bound; verify whether the UI displays 0.
Select the first visible supported value strictly above the recorded unity value; do not assume a step size.
Select the maximum supported value; record the exact visible value.

MS.selectionRule: Select the lower supported bound and record the exact visible value.
Select the first visible supported value strictly above the recorded unity value; retain 2 as a documented side-only reference when the UI supports it.
Select the maximum supported value; record the exact visible value.

documentedSemanticReferences: LR Spread 0 is a mono-sum reference and LR Spread 1 is neutral according to local reviewed documentation.
MS Spread 2 is a side-only reference when supported; record the visible UI value rather than assuming a range.

polarityAndChannelMatrix.inputSemantic: right channel delayed by one sample
100 Hz mid/low and 5 kHz anti-phase side/high

splitOffState.description: Split disabled; record one global Direction and Spread state at each LR/MS grid point.

crossoverSettings.selectionRule: Choose the nearest supported visible crossover to 500 Hz, between the fixture's 100 Hz low component and 5 kHz high component; record the exact visible UI value.
crossoverSettings.rationale: Separates the known 100 Hz and 5 kHz components while testing a low-band boundary.

crossoverSettings.selectionRule: Choose the nearest supported visible crossover to 2 kHz, still between the fixture's 100 Hz low component and 5 kHz high component; record the exact visible UI value.
crossoverSettings.rationale: Tests a materially different frequency split without assuming an undocumented range or step size.

branchStateMatrix.selectionRule: Set each branch independently to center and unity; record both visible values even if they match.
Low branch uses the recorded minimum spread; high branch uses the recorded above-unity spread; preserve each branch's direction value.
Use opposite quarter-turn directions for low and high branches and unity spreads; record both branch states independently.

splitDesign.independentBranchEvidence: Every split render requires a screenshot and state record showing crossover, low Direction, low Spread, high Direction, and high Spread; do not infer a branch value from the other branch.

include: full Direction Mixer panel with plugin name and every visible control
split toggle, crossover, low branch values, and high branch values
Logic project sample rate, buffer, low-latency, cycle range, and bounce settings
track/output routing, fader, pan/balance, inserts, sends, and automation visibility
correlation/level display when used; meters are supplementary and never replace audio analysis
stateScreenshots.redact: Do not include personal names, unrelated project paths, credentials, or cloud content.

settledRepeatRules.firstTransitionRetention: Retain the first render after insertion, bypass/re-enable, LR/MS change, Direction/Spread change, Split toggle, crossover change, branch change, and reload as transition evidence. Name it transition and never silently discard it.
settledRepeatRules.settledDefinition: After the transition render, stop transport, verify the visible panel state and routing, then acquire three consecutive renders without changing controls. Each settled render has repeatIndex 1, 2, or 3.
decisiveStates: each LR and MS spread grid point
each LR and MS direction grid point
each split crossover and branch-state combination
each polarity/channel-matrix fixture in the representative center/unity, minimum, above-unity, and extreme states
settledRepeatRules.divergenceRule: If settled decoded PCM or frame/channel metadata differs, retain all files, mark the state time-varying_or_unsettled, inspect the transition, and do not call it repeatable.

beforeSave: Save the disposable project normally with the current state and wait for completion.
Capture the project archive or package checksum and the after-save state screenshot.
Record the exact state values and source-copy hashes.
closeAndReopen: Quit or close the project normally; do not force-kill Logic.
Reopen the same project archive and verify sample rate, channel format, routing, plugin identity, bypass, mode, Direction, Spread, Split, crossover, and both branch states.
reloadRenders: Render one header-bypass or default control and one complex split state after reload through the same primary path.
Retain first-after-reload transition output, then acquire three settled repeats where required.
Compare decoded PCM and container hashes, frame count, sample rate, channel count, and all visible state values to the pre-reload record.
saveReloadProcedure.acceptance: A displayed value or project reopen alone is not sufficient; source and render hashes plus state screenshots are required. Any mismatch remains not_yet_evidenced.

renderForms: offline mono fold-down from the same stereo render or an explicitly documented mono bounce
measure: L/R RMS and peak, true-peak if available, and loudness with method
interchannel latency and polarity from impulse/one-sample-offset probes
sample correlation with window and normalization recorded
mono-sum RMS/peak/loudness and cancellation relative to stereo
Mid and Side energy, including low-band Side energy for the 100 Hz component
frequency-dependent response around the 100 Hz low and 5 kHz high fixture components
localization/channel identity notes only after measurement; no universal width score
monoPhaseAndSpatialAnalysis.lowBandDefinition: Use an explicitly recorded analysis filter that includes the fixture's 100 Hz component; 120 Hz is the prepared target, but record the actual filter and method used.
monoPhaseAndSpatialAnalysis.correlationBoundary: Correlation is a diagnostic number, not a mono-sum substitute or quality target.

fileAndPcmIdentity: SHA-256 of every fixture and copied source file
SHA-256 of every rendered WAV container
SHA-256 of decoded interleaved PCM bytes for every render
manifest SHA-256 comparison, frame count, channel count, sample rate, duration, encoding, and sourceUnchanged boolean
linearLane: same-path bypass baseline decoded PCM identity
latency-aligned impulse polarity, gain, peak, and tail
sweep magnitude, phase, and group delay with FFT/window/settings recorded
null residual after measured alignment where an LTI interpretation remains justified
nonlinearityRejectionLane: multitone harmonics/intermodulation and any alias products
stereoLane: left-only/right-only matrix, in-phase/anti-phase polarity behavior, one-sample offset, mid/side energy, correlation, mono sum, and low-band side
methodRecord: FFT size, window, hop, averaging, excluded bins, filter cutoffs, RMS/loudness window, alignment method, and software version
whether each measurement uses offline or real-time render and repeat index
requiredAnalysesAndHashes.noResultPlaceholder: Until native renders exist, analysis records remain not_yet_evidenced; generated fixture hashes do not satisfy a native processor result.

rejectionCriteria: Logic version is not 12.3 or its exact build is missing.
Project was not 48 kHz before import, or the imported source was not removed and re-imported after a rate change.
Fixture/source copy SHA-256 or decoded PCM differs from the manifest or pre-render record.
Render frame count, sample rate, bit depth, channel count, duration, alignment, or channel interpretation is wrong.
Bounce normalization, dither, metronome, count-in, hidden insert, send, automation, monitor effect, or unrecorded routing is present.
The plugin identity, mode, bypass, Direction, Spread, Split, crossover, or either branch state is not visible and recorded.
A split state reuses one branch's value without independently recording the other branch.
A first-transition render was discarded or mislabeled as settled.
Three settled repeats are missing for a decisive state or differ without a time-variance note.
Project save/close/reopen does not restore the exact visible state or the required hash comparison is missing.
Dropouts, clipping, NaN/Inf, unexpected tail, or unexplained extra frames occur.
Any result requires a guessed UI range/value, artistic interpretation, or unsupported Logic equivalence claim.

dimensionCoverage.futureEvidence: Native renders, screenshots, source hash, and decoded baseline comparison.
Visible selector/state screenshot and matching render for every supported discrete state; unsupported states are recorded as unavailable rather than skipped.
Exact visible values, screenshots, renders, and interaction analysis; no undocumented numeric values are presumed.
Audio analysis with alignment, polarity, gain, peak, tail, and method settings.
Three decoded-PCM/hash-checked settled files per decisive state or an explicit time-variance result.

preparedStatesOrActions: pre/post source and render hash comparison
dimensionCoverage.futureEvidence: Project archive hash, visible state match, reload renders, and unchanged source hashes.
Native state matrix plus stereo/mid-side/mono/polarity analysis.

preparedStatesOrActions: independent low/high Direction and Spread branch matrix
dimensionCoverage.futureEvidence: Exact crossover/branch values, frequency-dependent M/S transfer, crossover artifact inspection, and repeats.
Decoded audio measurements and state-linked analysis files.

preparedStatesOrActions: future human listening boundary for real source material
dimensionCoverage.futureEvidence: Measurements first; then a separate blinded/level-matched human source-specific listening record. Synthetic fixtures alone cannot close this dimension.

requiredFutureMaterial: legally usable stereo drums or drum bus
humanListeningBoundary.method: level-matched, randomized source-specific A/B or otherwise explicitly justified listening with identity-blind judgment, mono and headphone/speaker checks, and provenance/rights recorded
questions: Does the intended direction/width survive without focal-source loss?
Does the low end and mono fold-down remain acceptable for this source?
Are localization, phase, or crossover artifacts audible and material?
humanListeningBoundary.claimBoundary: No artistic superiority, quality, preference, or universal mono-compatibility claim may be made from this prepared package or synthetic fixture renders.

establishedNow: The required deterministic 48 kHz PCM24 fixture package and hash manifest exist.
The campaign's required generic and Direction Mixer-specific dimensions are mapped to future states/actions.
The later operator has exact source-copy, state capture, render, repeat, save/reload, rejection, and analysis instructions.
notEstablished: Any installed/native Logic behavior, transfer curve, latency, polarity, gain, phase, width, direction, split, crossover, or repeatability result.
An accepted, partial, or complete native profile.
Perceptual quality, artistic suitability, source-specific preference, or superiority.
Behavior outside the recorded Logic build, 48 kHz stereo lane, visible states, fixture conditions, and exact project/render path.
TrackSmith authority to insert, automate, edit, or control a Logic-native effect.
claimBoundary.generatedFixtureBoundary: Generated fixtures are deterministic probes, not real-instrument, real-vocal, or production-quality evidence.
